access_screening.access_notes: Source fact (Wikipedia): spring with agricultural terraces, watchtowers, winepresses, canals and pools; historically used by the villagers of al-Walaja. OSM: many mapped gates (several access=no or private) and paths, plus a track tagged asphalt with motor_vehicle=yes ~35 m from the untagged lot. This does not establish public vehicle access.
access_screening.acquisition_notes: Poor fit for 'easy/fast': bathers and privacy, an environmental permit, gate-controlled approaches and tree canopy over the spring. Water is not a geometric reference; terraces and stone pool edges are the target.
uncertainties: Untagged lot not accepted as a vehicle point.
Gate access=no/private tags may apply to the approach.
No authoritative source read.

access_screening.name: Khirbet Hanot (Hurvat Hanut / Havat Hanot)

uncertainties: Parking nodes are untagged; coordinate relies on adjacency to the named day-use site.
Public road connection and gates not established.
Heritage permission and mosaic exposure unverified.

scanning_plan.status: Provisional geographic grouping, not a measured shortest-road route. Confirm the daily public meeting point and vehicle access before routing.
scanning_plan.assumptions: One 2-3-person crew; separate RGB, LWIR and LiDAR acquisitions of compact subscenes, not whole parks. Eleven field-day slots plus two to five contingency/calibration/revisit days. All durations are planning allowances, not measured travel or operator quotes.

days.gate: Arrange separation from skaters, pedestrians and cyclists. Two OSM-supported vehicle points; opening and closure authority still need confirmation.
Municipal agreement and an empty controlled play area. No substantiated parking coordinates; never treat an early hour as permission or guaranteed absence of children.
Garden slot is conditional on a booked outdoor subscene and operator approval. Skip that slot if access is not arranged; do not capture a greenhouse building instead.
One shared kibbutz access agreement where applicable; separate heritage/flight approval and surrounding-area sensitivity screening remain required.
Dry terrain only at the reservoir, excluding dam/utility structures. National-park capture requires specific permission; no assumption that visitor access permits drones.
Tzuba ruins are conditional on legal approach and stable external viewpoints. Use the documented Sataf upper visitor lot; do not enter cultivated plots.
Confirm the ordinary-car approach to Saadim and a legal carry route to the winepresses. Winepress walking burden is unknown: leave its slot uncommitted until reconnaissance.
Both are conditional reserves: verify gates, ecological permissions, visitor privacy and any hospital/heliport constraints. Dense canopy may make the aerial result unsuitable.
Ein Yael requires an agreed booking; Ein Kobi vehicle access and the exact surface subscene remain unconfirmed. Exclude rail operations and underground waterworks.
Confirm public road connection and heritage conditions at the day-use area. No exposure or entry onto protected mosaics; allow close-range work on the permitted winepress scene.
Do not dispatch until a permitted open surface approach is confirmed. Allow a long equipment carry. Never enter closed trails, tunnels or unstable structures.

sequence: Before dispatch: confirm access, current airspace/security restrictions and site-specific permissions; check weather, emergency arrangements and pedestrian separation. A map pin is not a launch site.

At each approved site: select one bounded outdoor patch; record scene limits, lighting, weather and surface state; establish non-invasive control and independently reserved checkpoints where permitted.

Acquire separate RGB and raw/radiance-linear LWIR passes with consistent coverage and timestamps; record FFC/NUC events and sensor calibration. Select height, overlap and flight pattern only after the actual sensor, GSD target and authorised envelope are known.
Acquire the LiDAR reference and required external ground views, without entering protected or unsafe structures. Reference accuracy and cross-sensor registration must be validated independently.
Perform on-site completeness, exposure, timing and registration checks; copy data to two independent devices before leaving. Keep adjacent scenes together in benchmark splits.
scanning_plan.thermal_note: The shortest driving circuit is not necessarily the best thermal experiment. Keep a consistent chosen time window; a second dawn/day/night campaign is additional work, not included in this allowance.
scanning_plan.exclusions: Permit lead times, weather waits, extra day/night campaigns, extensive terrestrial laser scanning, processing and dataset release are excluded. Split any overloaded day rather than dropping control or QA.
scanning_plan.optimisation_limit: Only six candidate vehicle points have supporting map evidence, and several approaches remain unconfirmed. Pairings minimize obvious geographic backtracking, but no road-distance matrix or live traffic model was available. No claim of global shortest route, guaranteed access or approval probability is made.
